messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: HIGH - routing-pulse-burst on service=edge-router-prod. Trigger: 5m error-rate spike >150%. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/routing-pulse | PD: https://pd/redwood/incidents/IA12345

maria: acked. i'm oncall, looking now :raising_hand:

chetan: on it. seeing a short p95/p99 blip in us-west1 around the same time. no sustained 5xx spike in logs, looks like a warmup / cache-prefill pattern. can you confirm region, @maria?

maria: us-west1 confirmed. opening traces, pulling proxy logs.

ops-bot: runbook hint -> routing pulse: check autoscaler events, check kv cache hitrate, inspect proxy accept queue. if noisy and transient, consider short PD suppression.

jen: I saw the canary synthetic alert at ~15:42 too, small amplitude. support reports no customer errors. leaning noisy.

maria: quick scan: accept queue shows a burst of short lived tails, ttl spikes on KV prefetch. attaching a tiny metrics snippet:
```
avg_latency_ms: 24 -> 120 (1m)
error_rate_pct: 0.02 -> 0.06 (1m)
kv_hitrate: 0.77 -> 0.41 (spike)
```

chetan: confirms pattern: cold KV prefill + synthetic canary overlap. no downstream 500s, traces show retries within nodes. low customer exposure.

maria: going to apply very short suppression to avoid repeated noise. running: `pdctl suppression create --service routing-pulse-burst --duration 2m --reason 'noisy warmup/canary overlap'` :gear:

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: Suppression 'pulse-temp-451234' applied by maria for 2m.

maria: monitoring graphs. if it keeps spiking we'll escalate and run proxy restart, but hoping this is a one-off.

incident-bot: Pager resolved automatically at 4512345715. Incident status -> resolved (auto).

chetan: confirmed metrics back to baseline after suppression cleared. no follow-up errors in logs.

maria: lifting suppression, nothing else firing. filing a short post-incident note and handing off to next oncall. @jen can you file the one-paragraph blameless note and add to the weekly noisy-alerts list?

jen: yep will file: summary + idea to adjust the canary threshold or add short KV warmup fence. will also add an eval to Redwood Optimize checks to detect similar warmups. :memo:

maria: quick action items captured: 1) tune canary thresholds to avoid overlap, 2) add short KV prefill check to routing alert (suppress if no 5xx), 3) docs update for short suppression guidelines. Low customer impact, noise source identified as warmup + synthetic overlap. closing thread. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: reminder: consider adding a 'prefill stabilization' window to autoscaler policy to smooth short spikes.
